environment.description: Same binary deployed on hardened Amazon Linux 2023 instance. The instance runs with a custom seccomp-bpf profile (loaded via systemd unit SeccompFilter=) that permits only read/write/openat/close/fstat/mmap/mprotect(PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE only)/brk/exit_group/futex syscalls - critically mprotect with PROT_EXEC is denied returning EPERM. Additionally, the process credential material is sourced from AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation configured at 60-second intervals via a Lambda rotator (rotation uses AWSCURRENT/AWSPENDING staging labels with immediate invalidation of AWSPREVIOUS), and the CLI binary validates credential freshness by checking a signed timestamp embedded in the secret payload (JWT with 60s exp claim, signed with KMS asymmetric key). The instance IAM role has a permission boundary that denies secretsmanager:GetSecretValue unless aws:SecureTransport is true AND the request originates from the instance's VPC endpoint. Even if an attacker achieves code execution via the UAF, they cannot: (1) execute shellcode due to seccomp blocking mprotect(PROT_EXEC) and the W^X enforcement, (2) exfiltrate any valid credential because the rotated secret expires within 60s and the stolen in-memory copy was already zeroed by credential_cleanup, (3) pivot to retrieve fresh credentials because the permission boundary restricts secret access to the VPC endpoint path which requires the instance's IAM session token that rotates with the instance profile.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-bpf: allow read,write,openat,close,fstat,mmap,brk,exit_group,futex; allow mprotect WHERE !(prot & PROT_EXEC); deny-all-else with EPERM
config.credential_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager, 60s rotation via Lambda, AWSPREVIOUS immediately invalidated
config.credential_validation: JWT exp claim (60s TTL), signed with KMS asymmetric key (RSA-2048)
config.iam_permission_boundary: Deny secretsmanager:GetSecretValue unless aws:SecureTransport=true AND vpc-endpoint-condition
config.memory_protections: W^X enforced via seccomp mprotect filter
config.heap_hardening: glibc 2.38 with safe-linking and pointer mangling enabled
config.pie: binary recompiled with -fPIE -pie for this environment
